howto.name: Add the PDF
howto.text: Drop or select a PDF up to 500 MB. A thumbnail of every page is generated so you can see what you are rearranging.

howto.name: Reorder the pages
howto.text: Drag thumbnails into a new position, or use the move left and move right buttons for precise single steps.

howto.name: Remove pages you do not need
howto.text: Use the remove button on any thumbnail to leave that page out of the result.

howto.name: Save the new PDF
howto.text: Apply the changes and download the PDF with the pages in the order you arranged.

faq.q: What can I change with this tool?
faq.a: The order of the pages, and which pages are included. It does not rotate, edit or add pages; use Rotate PDF, Edit PDF or Merge PDF for those.

faq.q: Can I move a page from one PDF into another?
faq.a: Merge the two files first with Merge PDF, then open the merged document here and drag the page to where it belongs.

faq.q: Is there a quicker way to reverse every page?
faq.a: Yes. Reverse PDF flips the whole document in one step, which is handy when a scanner fed the pages last page first.
No. Pages are reordered, not re-rendered, so text stays selectable and images are not recompressed.

faq.q: Do the thumbnails mean my PDF is uploaded twice?
faq.a: The PDF is sent to the server to render the thumbnails and again to build the reordered file. Both requests use the same temporary per-request handling.

faq.q: What happens to my PDF after I upload it?
faq.a: It is uploaded over HTTPS and reorganised on the PrivaTools server in isolated temporary per-request storage, using local libraries rather than a third-party service. Response cleanup removes the PDF and the result after your download is sent, and a background sweep clears anything an interrupted request leaves behind. Nothing is added to an account or file library.
